description: Configuration application is atomic — either ALL settings are applied successfully or NONE are (no partial configuration state)
property: For any ConfigurationProfile application, either ALL settings are applied successfully or NONE are (no partial configuration state)

invariants.description: On success, both config.json and .onboarding_complete marker must exist. On failure, neither should exist (or state is unchanged).
On success, the written config.json must deserialize to a profile matching the input
No temporary files remain after application (success or failure)
